posts.title: A .JPG Extension Proves Nothing
bullets: Allowlist only file formats the application needs.
Verify actual file content; don't trust client Content-Type.
Rename uploads, limit size and store outside the webroot.
posts.caption:
A .jpg extension doesn't prove a file is safe. Allowlist required formats, verify actual file content, rename uploads, limit size, and store files outside the webroot. Treat every upload as untrusted.

#AppSec #FileUploadSecurity #SecureCoding #OWASP
